pageKvmConsole.title: KVM Console
pageKvmConsole.description: Remote KVM console with integrated server power operations
pageKvmConsole.confirmPowerOn: Are you sure you want to power on the server?
pageKvmConsole.confirmGracefulRestart: Are you sure you want to gracefully restart the server? This will attempt to shut down the OS properly before restarting.
pageKvmConsole.confirmForceRestart: Are you sure you want to force restart the server? This may cause data loss if the OS is not properly shut down.
pageKvmConsole.confirmGracefulShutdown: Are you sure you want to gracefully shut down the server? This will attempt to shut down the OS properly.
pageKvmConsole.confirmForceOff: Are you sure you want to force off the server? This may cause data loss if the OS is not properly shut down.
pageKvmConsole.confirmPowerCycle: Are you sure you want to power cycle the server? This will turn off and then on the power.
